name: Level-up stat growth
oneLiner: Experience and levels for a party: after a fight a results window counts EXP and gold up, each unit's gauge fills and wraps with LV UP! at every level, then a panel per levelled unit lists its stat gains row by row (+1 rows slide in with a highlight). Growth is a percent chance per stat per level from plain per-class tables, rolled with the module's own seeded RNG, with a guaranteed minimum so a level is never empty. The game supplies stat getters and setters and calls award(exp, gold) where the fight is won; stats change only through its setter. Save / load helpers for the EXP state.
fits: turn-based RPG battle (results after each battle or wave)
tactics RPG (EXP per hit and kill, tally after each unit's attack or at map end)
action RPG or dungeon crawler (EXP per enemy, level-up window between rooms)
monster-collecting and party RPGs (per-creature growth tables)
any game with a party whose numbers should grow between fights
notFor: skill trees or point-buy where the player spends points (a different element)
equipment and items that change stats (G-01 shop and inventory)
games without persistent units (one-off arcade runs)
online games where growth must be computed on a server

needs: a unit list (the party now): id, name, class, alive, and a getter and setter per stat the growth tables name
the one place in update logic where a fight / wave / map is won: award(exp, gold) there; what ran next moves into onDone
the confirm input routed to the window while busy() (press() on the key-down edge, or key(code, down))
a fixed 60 Hz update step (the window's only clock), also while the world is paused for it
the play field size in native px and ui rects to keep clear (HUD, command panel)
optional: the game's autoplay flag; per-hit EXP via addExp(id, n); the game's save to store serialize()
provides: levels and EXP per unit id (level, exp, toNext), an EXP curve (formula or table) and seeded per-class stat growth
stat changes delivered only through the game's setter, inside award(), each read back with the getter
busy flag: route the confirm input here and pause the world while the results window is open
tally end via onDone({exp, gold, levelUps, units: [{id, fromLevel, toLevel, gains, values}]}) (synchronous, inside update())
serialize() / restore() of the EXP state as plain JSON for a save
the window rectangle on screen, for other overlays to avoid

params.label: When EXP is awarded and the results window shows (required; the designer's words)
params.default: after every won battle: EXP and gold from the defeated enemies, for every living party member

params.label: Curve power (EXP for the next level = base x level^power)
Autoplay pace (ms a finished window stays)
Growth under autoplay (hold = keep the original ?auto=1 ending)
Window colour (a blue, n slate, b red)

assets: module/level-up-growth.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_LevelUpGrowth): EXP curve (formula or table), per-unit EXP state, seeded growth rolls with caps and a guaranteed minimum, setter-only stat changes with read-back, results window and level-up panel drawing (C-03 6x8 font built in), autoplay, queueing, serialize / restore
no image or audio files (sound cues are a callback; growth tables are plain data in the game)
